## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A gate report shows approve-unchanged and override rates per gate and owner...

The system SHALL ensure that a gate report shows approve-unchanged and override rates per gate and owner over a configurable window.

#### Scenario: A gate report shows approve-unchanged and override rates per gate and owner...

WHEN `trust-posture-calibration` is implemented
THEN A gate report shows approve-unchanged and override rates per gate and owner over a configurable window.

### Requirement: A trust-posture change proposal is generated when a gate crosses a...

The system SHALL ensure that a trust-posture change proposal is generated when a gate crosses a configured threshold and requires the posture owner's approval to apply.

#### Scenario: A trust-posture change proposal is generated when a gate crosses a...

WHEN `trust-posture-calibration` is implemented
THEN A trust-posture change proposal is generated when a gate crosses a configured threshold and requires the posture owner's approval to apply.

### Requirement: No trust-posture change is applied without a recorded decision by the...

The system SHALL ensure that no trust-posture change is applied without a recorded decision by the posture owner.

#### Scenario: No trust-posture change is applied without a recorded decision by the...

WHEN `trust-posture-calibration` is implemented
THEN No trust-posture change is applied without a recorded decision by the posture owner.
